## Gray Ape Legionnaire (CR 4)

**XP** 1,200  
Tombotu warrior 1  
LN Large monstrous humanoid  
**Init** +2; **Senses** darkvision 60 ft., scent; Perception +11  


**Defense**


**AC** 23, touch 11, flat-footed 21 (+6 armor, +2 Dex, +4 natural, +2 shield, -1 size)  
**hp** 85 (6d10+25)  
**Fort** +6, **Ref** +6, **Will** +5  


**Offense**


**Speed** 30 ft. (20 ft. in armor), climb 30 ft.  
**Melee** short sword +11/+6 (1d8 + 5/19-20), bite +5 (1d8 + 2) or bite +5 (1d8 + 2), 2 claws +5 (1d6 + 2 plus grab)  
**Ranged** javelin +7 (1d8 + 5)  
**Space** 10 ft.; **Reach** 10 ft.  
**Special Attacks** rend (2 claws, 1d6 + 7)  


**Statistics**


**Str** 21, **Dex** 15, **Con** 16, **Int** 11, **Wis** 12, **Cha** 11  
**Base Atk** +6; **CMB** +12 (+16 grapple); **CMD** 24  
**Feats** Alertness, [Toughness](../../rules/feats/toughness.md), [Weapon Focus (short sword)](../../rules/feats/weapon-focus.md); [Power Attack](../../rules/feats/power-attack.md) (no feat needed)  
*House rules: Endurance is part of Toughness; Power Attack needs no feat; in their place: Weapon Focus (short sword).*  
**Skills** Acrobatics +0 (-4 to jump), Climb +13, Diplomacy +3, Perception +11, Profession (sailor) +5, Sense Motive +3, Stealth +0, Swim +3  
**Languages** Althindu, Common, Tombotu  
**Other Gear** breastplate, heavy steel shield, javelin, short sword
